title: A Mass, Momentum, and Energy Conserving Semi-Lagrangian Adaptive-Rank (SLAR) Method for the Vlasov-Poisson System
summary: We propose a semi-Lagrangian adaptive-rank (SLAR) method that combines the large time-step capability of semi-Lagrangian schemes with the efficiency of adaptive-rank tensor representations while simultaneously enforcing local conservation laws for mass, momentum, and energy. The method builds on the high-dimensional SLAR framework introduced in our previous work and achieves high-order accuracy in both space and time.
